slides.headline: Around 80 games are hidden in this painting. How many did you play?
slides.sub: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, Children's Games, 1560

slides.headline: Flanders, 1560
slides.text: Bruegel let children take over an entire town. Streets, windows, a river, all full of games.

slides.headline: Start bottom left
slides.text: Two girls playing with dolls. Some things never change.

slides.headline: Rolling hoops
slides.text: Some hoops even have bells on them. You heard these kids coming.

slides.headline: Leapfrog
slides.text: 460 years old and still played in every schoolyard.

slides.headline: Blind man's buff
slides.text: One child blindfolded, spun around, trying to catch the others.

slides.headline: On stilts
slides.text: Short stilts and high stilts. Look how proud they are.

slides.headline: Right in the centre
slides.text: A pretend wedding procession. The children are playing at being adults.

slides.headline: Look far away
slides.text: Even the river in the distance is full of kids swimming. Which game did you play most? Tell us below.
